case_brief.subject: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
case_brief.what_it_is: The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana is a government scheme designed to encourage employment generation by providing financial incentives to new workers. It targets first-time employees entering the formal workforce and ensures social security coverage under the Employees Provident Fund (EPF).
case_brief.entitlement: Eligible employees receive a financial incentive of up to ₹15,000.
conditions: The employee must have joined a workplace between August 1, 2025, and July 31, 2027.
The employee must not have been a contributing member of the EPF or any exempted trust before August 1, 2025.
The employee's first EPF contribution must have been credited from the wage month of August 2025 onwards.
The employee must earn a monthly salary of up to ₹1 lakh, inclusive of all allowances and emoluments.
The employee must complete six months of continuous employment in the same establishment to qualify for the first instalment.

## If there's no reply
1. **Scheme grievance portal** (Official portal listed in the case brief) — First. Use the administering department's official scheme or service grievance portal.
2. **Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)** (Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances) — Escalate an unresolved grievance about a central government department or scheme. https://pgportal.gov.in
